desc: Ideation: sliding-window B-bit DP with fast-forwarding.
Implement full solution (merge, barrier check, mask DP, fast-forward, A==B case).

Verify correctness of window DP semantics (band = bits [A-1,B-1]) and fast-forward saturation bound T (k0*A+B-1 ≤ A(A-1)+B-1 < T), plus barrier rule (block length ≥ B impassable) and A==B forced-path check.
Stress-test / sample validation: solution passes all 3 public samples (Yes/No/Yes).
Performance analysis: O(M·T) with T≤425, M≤2e4 ⇒ ≲8.5M simple ops, acceptable.
